_about: Emily Elizabeth Constance Jones (1848-1922), Cambridge logician and Mistress of Girton College, joint translator of Lotze's Microcosmus. Raw IA OCR: Elements of Logic as a Science of Propositions (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1890); As I Remember, an autobiographical ramble (1922). Her surname is common, so only the full name form is used. US public domain. No uids minted.
